from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Captures the essential facts from a single judgment document needed for classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as written in the text")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action or case type explicitly stated in the document (e.g., 劳务合同纠纷)")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="The broad nature of the case, e.g., 'Civil' (民事) or 'Administrative' (行政)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
